verdict.rationale: Tavily ships an official MCP server exposing tavily-search and tavily-extract as tools, compatible with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any MCP client, letting AI-native users invoke Tavily via natural-language agent commands rather than raw API calls. Its SDK functions (search, qna_search, research) are also explicitly designed as single-call natural-language queries 'perfect for usage by LLMs.'
